items.text: Check your employment contract. Non-compete, moonlighting, client-conflict, and confidentiality clauses matter.

items.heading: Keep Company Data Out
items.text: Keep company data out of it. No employer files, contacts, templates, or internal knowledge should be reused carelessly.
